title: Insure workers for workers' compensation
what: Insure every worker under the state's workers' compensation scheme (or be a licensed self-insurer).

sources.title: Workers Compensation Act 1987 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: An employer (other than a self-insurer) shall obtain from a licensed insurer, and maintain in force, a policy of insurance that complies with this Division for the full amount of the employer's liability under this Act in respect of all workers employed by the employer
